title: Smallest Covering Window
prompt:
Given two strings s and t, find the shortest contiguous substring of s that contains every character of t, counting multiplicity (if t has two 'a's, the window needs at least two 'a's). Return that substring. If no such window exists, return the empty string "". When several shortest windows exist, return the one that starts earliest.

Example:
  min_cover_window("XADOBECODEBANC", "ABC") -> "BANC"
  min_cover_window("a", "aa") -> ""
